recognize_zh: 一個成熟外觀的淋巴球，核圓且染色質緻密，右側淡紫色胞質裡有數條彎曲如蚯蚓般的細絲狀包涵體，在 CLL 病人這是少見的胞質包涵體變異。
features: Single mature lymphocyte with round nucleus and dense homogeneous chromatin
Moderate lilac-gray cytoplasm, more abundant than a typical small lymphocyte
Several wavy, curvilinear filamentous inclusions in the cytoplasm
Background crenated red cells and scattered platelets
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a mature lymphocyte with a round nucleus, dense chromatin and moderately abundant pale cytoplasm containing several wavy curvilinear filamentous inclusions. Background red cells are partly crenated, and platelets are present. In a patient with CLL, findings are consistent with CLL cells harboring filamentous intracytoplasmic inclusions; electron microscopy or immunostaining can characterize the inclusion material.

ddx.vs: Hairy cells show surface cytoplasmic projections at the cell border rather than internal filaments.

ddx.dx: Lymphoma with crystal-storing histiocytosis or crystalline inclusions in plasma cells
ddx.vs: Crystal inclusions in plasma cells are rhomboid or needle-like in eccentric-nucleus plasma cells with a perinuclear hof.
Drying artifact produces irregular refractile folds across red cells as well, whereas true inclusions are confined to lymphocyte cytoplasm.
